content: Current PG body matches are accepted with wrong content_sha256 or missing doc_id unchanged; per-result replay question is not bound to the gold question. Three owning-entry failures reproduce inconsistent source/request metadata.
All unit_chunk_links are labeled table_unit without checking source_units.unit_kind. Read-only live classification proves 29 of 41 new paths are blocks falsely labeled tables; only 12 are tables.

Error text is truncated before secret replacement, leaking a fixture-secret prefix; the terminal writer also skips sanitization of preflight details. Both owning-entry failures use synthetic secrets; no actual credential leak was observed.
